title: The Influence of Code Smells in Efferent Neighbors on Class Stability
abstract: arXiv:2602.12950v3 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Understanding what drives code instability is essential for effective software maintenance, as unstable classes require larger or more frequent edits and increase the risk of unintended side effects. Although code smells are widely believed to harm maintainability, most prior stability studies examine only the smells within the class being modified. In practice, however, a class can change because its efferent neighbors (i.e., the classes it depends on) are modified due to ripple effects that propagate along static dependencies, even if the class itself is clean. Such ripple effects may be more severe when efferent neighbors exhibit code smells. Therefore, this study investigates whether code smells in a class's efferent neighbors affect its stability. translated_title: 输出邻居中的代码坏味道对类稳定性的影响
translated_abstract: 理解驱动代码不稳定性的因素对于有效的软件维护至关重要，因为不稳定的类需要更大或更频繁的修改，并会增加产生意外副作用的风险。尽管代码坏味道被广泛认为会损害可维护性，但以往大多数关于稳定性的研究仅考察被修改类内部的坏味道。然而在实践中，即使某个类本身是“干净”的，它也可能因为其输出邻居（即其所依赖的类）因沿静态依赖传播的涟漪效应而被修改而发生变化。当输出邻居存在代码坏味道时，这种涟漪效应可能会更加严重。因此，本研究旨在探究类的输出邻居中的代码坏味道是否会影响该类自身的稳定性。我们从152个GitHub上星标数最高的Java项目中挖掘了一年的提交历史，检测了代码坏味道和静态依赖，并对其与类稳定性之间的关联进行了建模。我们的研究……
tldr: 本研究基于152个热门GitHub Java项目一年的提交历史，首次揭示了类的输出邻居（即其所依赖的类）中存在的代码坏味道会通过涟漪效应影响该类自身的稳定性。
en_tdlr: This study reveals, based on one year of commit history from 152 top-starred GitHub Java projects, that code smells in a class's efferent neighbors (the classes it depends on) can affect the class's own stability through ripple effects.
